headline: Failed motion to reconsider votes on Council Orders 26-242 and 26-243.
summary: The council considered a motion to rescind and reconsider its votes on Council Orders 26-242 and 26-243. The motion failed by a vote of 2 to 7.
decisions: Failed motion to rescind and reconsider votes on Council Orders 26-242 and 26-243, vote 2-7.
